summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Diversity and Inclusion in the oil and gas sector. Empower your team and drive positive change in your organization.
lede: Intercultural training in oil and gas develops inclusive collaboration across culturally and generationally diverse teams. It is for operations and project managers, supervisors, HSE, HR and technical leaders who shape workplace practices and team culture. Participants learn to recognize bias, lead inclusive meetings and safety conversations, and address harassment while supporting people to speak up about hazards and concerns.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for oil and gas professionals who play a pivotal role in influencing people, processes, and culture within their organizations.
audience: Operations managers and supervisors in upstream, midstream
Diversity, ESG, and sustainability officers in energy
Site managers and camp supervisors in remote
Anyone in the oil and gas value
modules: Business Case for Diversity and Inclusion in Oil and Gas
Understanding Bias and Everyday Behaviour in the Energy Workplace
Inclusive Leadership on Sites, Platforms, and in Offices
Recruitment, Promotion, and Talent Pipelines in Oil and Gas
Cross Cultural and Multi Generational Teams in Global Operations
Inclusion, Safety Culture, and Speaking Up
Working with Contractors, Partners, and Local Communities
Data, Metrics, and Accountability for D&I in Oil and Gas
Action Planning and Sustaining an Inclusive Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of the oil and gas industry and experience in team or project leadership roles.
